_about: English. To add a language: copy this file to <code>.json, translate the values, and add the code to languages.json. Keys you leave out fall back to English. Values may hold a little HTML (links, <em>, <b>).
meta.title: FilianWIKI: the Snackers remember everything
hero.title: The Snackers remember everything. Now it's written down.
hero.lede: FilianWIKI is a fan wiki for Filian's community: lore, clips, emotes, the running jokes and the arcs you slept through, in one place no platform can take away. It runs on its own engine, with no ads and no trackers. Right now it is a closed alpha, and we let people in by hand.
hero.hint: Grab the cat and spin it. Poke it too.
counts.note: Paid for by donations and spare evenings. AGPL licence, so nobody gets to lock the engine away later, and skins stay with the people who draw them.
tape.one: FAN PROJECT ✦ NOT AN OFFICIAL FILIAN SITE ✦ NOT PART OF ANY ARG ✦ JUST A WIKI ✦
tape.two: MADE BY SNACKERS ✦ FOR SNACKERS ✦ NO ADS ✦ NO TRACKERS ✦ SOURCES OR IT DIDN'T HAPPEN ✦
disclaimer.one: Fans run this site. Filian has nothing to do with it and hasn't endorsed it, and nobody here speaks for her or her team.
disclaimer.two: It isn't part of any ARG either. No puzzles, no clues, no hidden layers. If something here looks like a riddle, it's a joke or a bug, and you can tell us.
wiki.title: Six rooms, one house
wiki.lede: Written by people who watch the streams, with a source for every claim. Nothing generated, nothing stretched out for ad views.
tile.character_text: Filian as a character: looks, models, history, and the facts chat keeps asking about.
tile.lore_text: Arcs and storylines in order, so a newcomer catches up in one evening instead of a year of VODs.
tile.glossary_text: Every emote, callback and chat word explained, and the joke survives.
tile.schedule_text: When the streams are, what's planned, and what happened last time.
tile.clips_text: Searchable, timestamped, linked to the source. Not screenshots of screenshots.
tile.fan_art_text: Every piece with its artist's name and a link. Credit isn't optional here.
join.title: We take anyone. Just ask.
join.lede: No résumé, no years in the fandom required. If you want to be part of this, you're in. Right now we're especially short on
join.how: The alpha is closed, so accounts are made by hand. Write to vadim+calpha@filian.wiki or vadim@filian.wiki with "closed alpha" in the subject and fill in the four lines below. Vadim reads every one himself.
join.copy_failed: Couldn't copy it, select the text by hand
join.age_text: Something like 14+ or 18+. Some countries have strict rules for teens, and the line is only there for them. Write what you're comfortable with.
join.who_text: Dev, bug hunter, just a Snacker, clipper, VTuber, translator, anything. Discord mods of SnackersHQ+ or SnackersRU: say so, then DM vai_prog to verify.
join.lang_text: The template is in English so every letter looks the same. Answer in whatever language you like.
roadmap.title: The recipe, and how far along we are
roadmap.lede: The short version of the roadmap. The full one is public, unfinished parts and all.
phase.one_text: Schema, licence and stack chosen, and the reasons written down.
phase.two_text: Reading, editing, history with proper diffs, protected pages, signing in.
phase.three_text: Search that shrugs at 5 MB articles, infobox templates, file pages like on Commons.
phase.four_text: First people inside. Reports to moderators, an audit log, 7TV emotes and a lot of polishing.
phase.five_text: A wikitext importer and an open export, so leaving is as easy as arriving.
domains.title: Real addresses get a stamp
domains.lede: Our addresses are stamped below. Anything else that looks like us isn't us. Not sure about one? Show it at the desk.
domains.ru: ours too, with a Win95 desktop
domains.warn: We'll never ask for your Twitch or Discord password, and we'll never run a giveaway that needs your wallet.
places.title: While it's being built
places.lede: The community already exists, and it's more fun than any coming-soon page. Every ticket says where it leads. Tear off the stub to go in.
places.discord_text: The main community server. New here? Start with this one.
places.ru_text: The Russian speaking corner of the community. Not run by Filian, same as this wiki.
places.arg_text: If the ARG brought you here, this is the server that actually works on it, and we're not them. Their archive is on Google Drive.
places.coffee_text: Donation options live on vai-rice.space. Helps, never expected.
places.mail_text: vadim@filian.wiki reaches a human. Please don't flood it, it's the one inbox he actually reads.
quote.note: he wrote that at 3am and stands by it.
credits.duo: Under VAI_PROG Development and Curated by Akane (Simply not another prog girl that just solves things). Unexpected but powerful duo.
credits.vai: Vadim Khristenko signs his work VAI. Rust developer, open source, and a Snacker himself, which is the only reason any of this exists.
credits.akane: Akane curates. She reads every diff, argues about fonts, and wrote the music playing on this page.
credits.art: The logo, the icon and the character art are by just.call.me.l.
credits.stack: 3D by Three.js, letters by Unbounded and Golos Text, music by the Web Audio API. Not a single tracker.
